ticks.note: Player A is ready: `PlayerA` reaches its final state, `ReadyA`.

In the same tick player A leaves (`ReadyA` → `WaitingA`) and player B gets ready (`WaitingB` → `ReadyB`). At the end of the tick only `PlayerB` is in a final state, so `Gathering` has not terminated and the game does not start.
Player A is ready again. Now both regions are in final states at the same time: the join fires and `playing` is true.
